translations.web: Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;
translations.bsb: Therefore we are always confident, although we know that while we are at home in the body, we are away from the Lord.
translations.kjv: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:
translations.asv: Being therefore always of good courage, and knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord
